boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UMD study environments, from reservable carrels to library reading and group-work spaces.

cards.title: Set up in the Terrapin Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Use this McKeldin learning commons when you want library resources nearby; check the library’s current hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named learning commons inside UMD’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Libraries identifies the Terrapin Learning Commons as a component of McKeldin Library.
cards.access_notes: Located in McKeldin Library; current library hours are posted by UMD Libraries and may change.

cards.title: Book an individual McKeldin carrel
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, floors 3, 4, and 6
cards.notes: Use the library’s Find a Space tool to locate an individual room, then confirm the carrel’s availability and booking requirements.
cards.short_summary: Individual study rooms for undergraduate students across three McKeldin floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that McKeldin has individual undergraduate study rooms, called study carrels, on floors 3, 4, and 6.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces & Tools | Student Success Office
cards.access_notes: For undergraduate students; use Find a Space for current room details and availability.

cards.title: Work among the fifth-floor stacks
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, fifth floor
cards.notes: Choose the fifth-floor Quiet Zone for a focused library session, and use the floor map to find open study carrels and collections.
cards.short_summary: A mapped Quiet Zone with study-carrel seating on McKeldin’s fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The McKeldin floor map labels the fifth floor a Quiet Zone and identifies open study carrels in the building.
cards.access_notes: Inside McKeldin Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Find a sixth-floor quiet seat
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, sixth floor
cards.notes: Head to the sixth-floor Quiet Zone when you need a quieter library setting; use the map legend to identify the carrel seating.
cards.short_summary: A separately mapped Quiet Zone on McKeldin’s sixth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The McKeldin floor map labels the sixth floor a Quiet Zone and includes open and reservable study-carrel symbols.
cards.access_notes: Inside McKeldin Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Use the seventh-floor Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, seventh floor
cards.notes: Bring your reading or writing to the seventh floor and use the McKeldin map to orient yourself to study carrels and nearby stacks.
cards.short_summary: A top-floor Quiet Zone in UMD’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The McKeldin floor map labels the seventh floor a Quiet Zone and shows study-carrel seating as a library feature.
cards.access_notes: Inside McKeldin Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library Main Reading Room
cards.title: Read in the Performing Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Use the main reading room when your work involves music, theatre, or dance materials; confirm the library’s day-specific hours first.
cards.short_summary: A main reading room in UMD’s performing-arts-focused library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library as including a main reading room.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center; current hours are posted by UMD Libraries.

cards.entity_name: Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library Individual Study Carrels
cards.title: Take an individual carrel at M-SPAL
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Use an individual carrel for concentrated work with performing-arts materials, and check current library access information before arriving.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels in UMD’s music, theatre, and dance library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library includes individual study carrels.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center; current hours are posted by UMD Libraries.

cards.entity_name: Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library Group Study Room
cards.title: Plan a group session at M-SPAL
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Coordinate with your group before going, then verify whether the room is available or needs to be reserved through current library channels.
cards.short_summary: A documented group study room in the Performing Arts Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library includes a group study room.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center; confirm current room-use procedures and library hours.

cards.title: Research at the Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Architecture Building
cards.notes: Bring architecture or design research here to work near materials on design, theory, history, urban design, landscape architecture, and building technology.
cards.short_summary: A subject library for architecture and built-environment research.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies the Architecture Library in the Architecture Building and lists its architecture and design subject coverage.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Architecture Building; check UMD Libraries for current operating hours.

cards.title: Settle in at the STEM Library
cards.subtitle: Mathematics Building
cards.notes: Use this library when your work draws on engineering, computing, mathematics, or natural sciences resources; check today’s posted hours first.
cards.short_summary: A Mathematics Building library serving STEM disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies the STEM Library in the Mathematics Building as serving engineering, computer, mathematical, and natural science disciplines.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Mathematics Building; check UMD Libraries for current operating hours.
